newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Aug 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi Arabia - Aug 29.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Yemeni President Saleh received visiting Saudi Defence Minister Prince Sultan who flew to Sanaa on Wednesday.
- Total sales of Savola Company of Saudi Arabia, the main supplier of cooking oil in the kingdom, rose 18 percent in the first six months to 120 million riyals.
- Saudi Arabia's toy market poised to grow by three percent a year. The kingdom imports toys worth 250 million riyals a year.
- A 10-member Saudi mining team which includes senior executives from private sector firms to attend an exhibition in the United States.
- Commerce Minister Faqeeh meets Syrian prime minister for talks on developing commercial relations.
